tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgyud sde spyi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bdud bzhi dang sgrib gnyis sreg cing tshogs gnyis 'od zer 'gyed byed ces bya ba rje mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa sor bzhag las bzhi myur 'grub las zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bzhugs so/// /

bla ma dam pa dang lhag pa'i lha gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dam tshig dang sdom pa ldan zhing rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor pas zhi sogs kyi las rnams bsgrub pa dang*/ dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par bya ba dang*/ sngags dang cho ga'i lhag chad kha dgang ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi las dang*/ rten rab tu gnas pa la sogs pa dang 'brel ba'i tshe sbyin sreg gi las brtsam ste/ dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las/ sna tshogs las ni rab bsgrub phyir// sbyin sreg las ni bshad par bya// me ni lha yi kha ru gsungs// sbyin sreg de nyid rnam par gnas// sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshims// tshims nas dngos grub rab tu stsol// gang zhig sngags kyi lhag chad dag /sbyin sreg gis ni de kun dgang*// ces dang*/ ci gsungs sbyin sreg byas nas ni// dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs pa dang*// zhes dang*/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ rab gnas la sogs rjes la ni// ma dran pa dang ma nus pa// cho ga ma tshang gyur ba rnams// sbyin sreg gis ni rdzogs par bya// zhes gsungs so// de la 'dir rgyud sde spyi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bdud bzhi dang sgrib gnyis sreg cing tshogs gnyis 'od zer 'gyed byed ces bya ba rigs sngags 'chang ba chen po slob dpon karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa sor bzhag las bzhi myur 'grub ces bya ba las zhi ba'i sbyin sreg khol du phyung ba'i las kyi rim pa 'jug pa la gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo// dang po la gsum ste/ thab bca' ba/ yo byad rnams ji ltar bsham pa/ slob dpon gyi chas gos sogs bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ sam+bu ṭi las/ zhi ba thab khung zlum po ni/ khru khang tshad tsam thig gdab bya// btab nas khru phyed brkos nas ni// 'og tu sa la mtho gang khung*// tsan dan dkar pos ngos dag byug /de yi phyi rol zlum po'i sa// sor bzhi pa yi mu ran yin// ces bstan pa ltar/

gang du sbyin sreg bya ba'i gnas su stegs bu 'du bya ba sogs grub nas/ thog mar thig gdab pa ni/ tshangs zur bzhi po legs btab ste// dbus nas lag sor bcu gnyis dang*// slar yang bzhi pa gnyis rim bskor// rgya khyon mchu dang kha khyer yin// de dbus sor bzhi pad lte bskor// tshangs zur dbus gshag gcus thig gdab// pad 'dab brgyad 'byung zhi ba 'grub// de ltar thig rnams gdab par bya// de nas thab khung brtsig na/ zhi ba la mchu'i phyi nang gi thig gnyis kyi bar du zlum por brtsegs pa'i rgya phyed dpangs su yod pa'i kha nas sor bzhi pa'i mchu dor bar rgya dpangs mnyam par sor bzhi pa'i kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang bcas pa pad+ma rgyas pa'i dbyibs lta bu nang du ngang gis gzhol ba de'i phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje/ dbus su pad 'dab brgyad de/ zhi ba las thams cad pa la phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan sngo/ lte ba ljang gu'i steng du rdo rje dkar po/ phyogs kyi 'dab bzhi la rigs bzhi'i lha mtshan/ de yang gtso bo 'pho ba'i tshe lha mtshan 'pho tshul shes par bya/ dpa' gcig la phyogs kyi mtshan ma mi dgos/ zhi ba kho na'i las yin na pad+ma thams cad dkar po bya'o// brko thab byed na kha khyer gyi rtsa thig gi nang du thab rang rang gi rgya'i phyed zabs su brko zhing bris thab la ni dpangs dngos su med kyang bsam pas 'grub bo// thab kyi kha dog dang dbyibs ni gong gi lung dang 'og tu thab bskyed chog gis rtogs par 'gyur ro// bud shing ni yam shing so so'i rgyu dang mthun pa'am shug pa sogs dri zhim po dang dgon pa'i ba glang gi lci ba srog chags med pa yang rung ste/ thab kyi dbyibs dang dpangs rnams dang mthun par thab kyi mchu'i nang du dam par brtsigs pa'i nang gi shar lhor rdza'i kong bu las mthun gyi mar gyis bkang ba sdong bu can gzhag go// /gnyis pa yo byad bsham bkod kyi rim pa ni/

zhi bar slob dpon gyi g.yon phyogs nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du rim pa bzhin chu bzhi/ nyer spyod lnga/ mar la bcos pa'i gtor ma dang bcas pa stegs bu mtho dman nam phyi nang byas pa'i khar 'das ma 'das kyi tshar gnyis bsham/ ma 'byor na tshar gcig spyi sor bshams la mchod 'bul re re bzhin mchod pa rnams brje ba'am kha gso/ yang g.yas phyogs kyi mdun ngos nas brtsams te snga ma bzhin du zhi bar yam shing byang chub kyi shing sogs 'o ma can lnga bshad kyang bod du mi 'byor bas ba lu sogs 'o ma can du btags pa'i rtse mo'i cha las byung ba slob dpon gyi mthe'u chung gi tshad tsam sor bcu gnyis pa/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ 'o ma mar khu rnams kyis rtse mo sbags pa ji tsam 'os pa dang*/ ba'am ra'i mar gyi khu ba/ til nag /yungs kar/ zho bag phye bu ram gsum mam/ 'o ma sbrang rtsi zhib bsres pa'i ril bu'i zas mchog dang*/ zho/ 'bras so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dūr+wa/ ku sha sngon po rtsa rtse ma nyams pa mar dang 'o mas sbags pa dang*/ shing tog sna tshogs rnams dang*/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong sogs dmigs bsal la phye gtsang mar gong gsal rdzas rnams ka ṭo ra chen por phyogs gcig tu bsres pa bung skyed de bsham mo// slob dpon gyi mdun me yol gyi nang du g.yon nas rim bzhin me lha'i gdan gyi ku sha chun po bcu/ nang mchod rdo rje/ dgang blugs kha sbyar dril bu/ me tog bsang gtor gyi ku sha /rlung g.yab rnams bsham/ gzhan yang las mthun gyi khrus ras dang gos zung dag kyang bsham mo/// /gsum pa slob dpon gyi chas gos sogs bstan pa ni/ zhi bar gos dkar po bgo zhing rgyan yang shel lam mu tig rigs lnga thor tshugs cod pan bcas so// slob dpon gyi kha lta phyogs ni/ zhi bar kha shar du blta bar sam+bu ṭi las gsungs shing*/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na thab dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs gang du bya ba'ang de nyid las/ shar gyi phyogs su zhi ba yin// ces gsungs pas dkyil 'khor gyi zhal gang du phyogs kyang rung*/

las dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su thab bca' zhing*/ slob dpon ni las dang mthun pa'i phyogs su kha blta ba'am/ yang na sbyin sreg dang 'brel ba'i skabs su dkyil 'khor gyi zhal nub phyogs su lta bar bzhes na/ zhi ba la sogs pa'i las kun la dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs gang du bya ba dang*/ slob dpon gang du kha blta ba'i 'byung ba'i phyogs gnyis ka mi 'gal bas shin tu 'grig cing legs par mngon no// slob dpon gyi gdan dang 'dug stangs ni/ zhi ba la 'jam pa'i gdan dkar po la pad+ma'i 'dug stangs bya/ dus ni zhi bar bco lnga sogs kyi srod dang tho rangs sogs so so'i las dang mthun pa'i nyams kyis bya'o/// /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ 'jig rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i cho ga'o// dang po ni/ bdag nyid khrus byas las dang mthun pa'i tshon dang dris byugs/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel na bdag bskyed thun bsdu yan 'gro bas 'thus shing*/ ma 'brel kyang zhi sogs las thams cad pa yin na cho ga so so'i bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms shing thun bsdus la/ slar rang nyid las kyi he ru kar gsal gdab/ zhi sogs las rkyang pa yin na lha thams cad dkar por bsgom pa sogs su bshad do// 'dir 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu'i dkyil chog la mtshon na/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das sogs nas/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed thun bsdu sogs bya'o// gzhan des 'gre bas yi dam gang mos la sbyar chog /da lam 'dir rgyal rgyam lha dgur sbyar ba'o// 'di nas bzung ste sbyin sreg ma grol gyi bar ngag smra bcad/ lag pa rdor dril/ yid ting 'dzin dang ma bral bar dgos shing*/ rdor dril byin rlabs sngar byas pa med na 'dir byin brlab dgos pas cho ga so so las byung ba ltar ram/ yang na rdor dril la nang mchod gtor la/

oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kri ta badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dho3 haṃ gyis sbyangs/ rdor dril mi dmigs stong nyid gyur// stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng*// hūm̐ las rdor sems yab yum dkar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdol dril 'dzin// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ye shes pa// dbang gi lhar bcas spyan drangs te// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥye shes pa// dam tshig pa dang dbyer med gyur// slar yang dbang lha 'khor bcas kyis/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag spyi bor brtan pa las// mi bskyod pa yis dbu brgyan gyur// rdor sems yab yum zhu ba las// rdor dril mtshan nyid ldan par gyur// lag gnyis bkan la/ lag mthil g.yas su zla ba dang*// g.yon du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal// bar bsams te pad skor dang bcas pas/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje blangs te gsor/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe āḥ zhes pad skor dang bcas te dril bu blangs la/ slar yang pad skor dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dhā ṇa ra yā mi badz+ra sa twa hī hi hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod bzhin pas rdo rje gsum gsor/ slar bstod de snying gar bzung ngo*// de nas dril bu gnas brgyad du bskor zhing bsil ba ste dril lce dril bu'i nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du res mos kyis reg par gsil bzhin par/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe ra ṇi ta pra ri ni ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba bud+dha k+she tra pra tsā li ni pra dz+nyā pa ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha bi ta badz+ra dharma hṛ da yaṃ san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥ.ā khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod la pad skor byas te rdo rje snying gar bzung zhing dril bu sgra che ba gsum dkrol bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sgras bskul zhing mchod par bsams te grags stong du mnyam par bzhag go// /de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma la bdud rtsi sogs bran/

oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kri ta badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa dang*/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs kyis bsang sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang rang gi spyod yul du gyur pa'i snod rnams su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na tātwa oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ skad cig gis rang nyid dpal rta mchog he ru kar gsal bar gyur/ lag gnyis rdo rje'i khu tshur rgyab sbyar ba'i mthe'u chung sbrel zhing*/ mdzub mo bgreng bas/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa'i mthus/ gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams skad cig nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig /ṭāk+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ so so'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ dhū pe= puṣ+pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wid+ya= shab+da= rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te/ s+pha ra na i ma ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇa i daṃ ba liṃ d+ya swā hā/ lan gsum/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ gang dag dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la// mngon par dga' ba gang yin rnams// legs bshams mchod pa gtor ma dag /bzhes nas bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// gang dag dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthong ba dang thos par mi dbang ba'i bgegs de dag gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su song zhig

/gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la rab tu 'bar ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen pos mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o// ces pa'i bar gyis gtor ma btang*/ rol 'og tu/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kri ta badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wā na bid+ya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa brjod/ drag sngags bzlas pa'i yungs kar gyis rdzas dang yo byad kun la brab cing bgegs bskrad/ bsrung 'khor ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pad+ma/ g.yon bgrang phreng*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar/ hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba/ de'i 'od zer las khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i tshogs dang*/ me ri dang mtshon cha'i tshogs spros te/ bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad tshar bcad nas/ slar 'od zer las 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur khang du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gyis srung 'khor brtan par bsgom mo// me sbar ba ni/ gtsubs shing las byung ba'am rung khang las 'byung ba'i me/ me snod du bzhag ste bsangs chu gtor la/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kri ta badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ dpal 'bar la sbar te slar yang bsangs chu gtor la/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kri ta badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes thab kyi shar lhor bzhag /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rlung g.yab kyis g.yab cing sbar ro// yang bud shing nyung ba lta bus mgyogs par dgos tshe me lha'i gdan bshams nas sam me lha bskyed nas me sbar ba'ang yod do// de nas dkyil 'khor gang yin de'i las sngags sam so so'i snying po bzla dgos par gsungs pas 'dir/

oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kri ta badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mar khu dgang blugs gsum mam bdun phul bas me gsos la/ sam+bu ṭir/ thab khung kun tu ku sha yi// rtse mo drangs por yongs su bskor// zhes pa ltar ku sha'i chun po ma nyams shing ha cang ring thung spang ba zung du byas pa dag rim par blangs te lag gnyis kyis bzung ba cung zad pad bskor bcas te/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ zhes chun po che ba zung zhig thab kyi steng du rtse shar du blta bas bzhag ste me lha'i gdan du bsam/ chun po gzhan dag ni rang gi phyogs g.yon nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du rim pa ltar rtse mo shar dang lho dang nub dang byang du blta bar stegs bu g.yogs shing snga ma'i rtse mo phyi ma'i rtsa bas non pa bskor thabs su dgram mo// 'di ni me lha'i gdan dang sbyin sreg gi bya ba la srung 'khor du yang 'gyur bas thog mar bya zhing thab bskyed pa'i gong ngam 'og tu bya ba yang yod do// de nas mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ bdug spos/ me tog /mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin dwangs shing thogs pa med pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed rgyas par 'gengs shing 'phro ba/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su gyur/

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yāṃ= a tsa mā naṃ= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= dhū pe= puṣ+pe= a lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wid+ya= shab+da āḥhūm̐/ de nas bsreg rdzas byin brlabs ni cho ga so so'i gtor ma'am nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab dgos pas 'dir/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta sogs/ oṃ swa bha wa= stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi thugs ka nas/ yaṃ 'phros pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam ba dan dang yaṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ spros pa las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po 'bar ba raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de la kaṃ gsum spros pa las thod pa skam po bum ril gyi sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a spros pa las thod pa'i snod phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dbus su mu las dri chu baiḍūr+ya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor ra las rak+ta gser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las klad pa ste bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lhor go las ba lang gi sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha /byang shar du ha las rta yi sha ste sha lnga'o// rlung g.yos shing me sbar bas thod pa dros rdzas rnams zhu ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog sngon po'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog dkar po 'o ma'i rgya mtsho lta bur gyur/ ces pa'i bar byin gyis brlabs la de nas/ ngo bo bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin la// rnam pa bsreg rdzas so sor gyur// zhes sbyar te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ zhes lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas blugs gzar g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas dgang gzar bzung ba kha sbyar te mar khu la reg cing*/ de bzhin du/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ yam shing la reg ste/

oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ 'bru thams cad la reg ste/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hā/ rdzas sbyang ba'o// yang sreg rdzas thams cad la reg ste/ oṃ swā hā/ rdzas bkru ba'o// yang rdzas thams cad la rim par reg ste/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas thab bskyed pa ni/ las sngags kyis bsangs dgos pas/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ thab khung mi dmigs stong nyid gyur// stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng*// hūm̐ las zhi thab zlum po dkar// lag khru gang gi rgya khyon can// rgya phyed dpangs ldan sor bzhi yi// mchu dang kha khyer de steng du// rdo rje dkar po'i phreng ba dang*// grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje spras// de dbus pad+ma 'dab brgyad lter// zhi ba'i rdo rjes mtshan par gyur// thab kyi dbus su me dkyil nang*// pad nyi'i steng du ram̐ yig las// zhi ba'i me lha dkar po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis me thab dang*// ril ba 'dzin pa drang srong tshul// ral pa'i tshogs can zhi nyams ldan// gsus 'phyang tshangs skud dkar pos brgyan// ra skyes la gnas 'khor bcas kyi// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros shar lho nas// me lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs te// lag pa g.yon pas g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste/ ku sha dang bcas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya bcas la mthe bong gis srin lag gi rtsa bar g.yob cing*/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// lha yi rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad rab sgrub pa// thugs rjes sems can don gyi phyir// 'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol// oṃ ṭāk+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs thab kyi shar lhor me tog gcig 'phangs la/ thab kyi shar lhor ku sha yi// gdan la me lha ye shes pa// 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs par gyur// bzed zhal so sor chu bzhi sbreng ste/

oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ pād+yaṃ/ a tsa mā naṃ/ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa chu bzhi dbul/ de nas lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan pa rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la ya sarba bhasmin ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya haṃ/ zhes dam la bzhag /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥye shes pa// dam tshig pa dang dbyer med gyur// slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od kyis// rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs te// dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu zhabs spyi bor brtan pa las// rnam snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan gyur// ces dang me lha'i mchod phreng phul la/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe/ a lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wid+ya/ shab+da'i bar gyis gdan mchod dbul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍak+kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces bstod/ dgang blugs kha la hūm̐ yig gsal// me lha cung zad zhal gdangs pa'i// ljags la raṃ yig gis mtshan pas// bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi bzhes par gyur// na mas+sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ oṃ ag+na ye ha bya ka bya wa ha nā ya ā di bya/ zhes lag gnyis rdor dril dang dgang blugs 'dzin zhing byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas mar khu dgang blugs gsum mam bdun byon zan du 'bul te/ spel tshig ni/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon kun// sarba shin+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ ces 'dod don gsol zhing sngags tshig rnams brjod bzhin pas/ lag gnyis rdor dril dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i khu tshur las/

mdzub mo brkyang pas dgang blugs bzung*/ g.yas pa'i blugs gzar gyis mar khu gsum mam bdun sogs dgang gzar du blugs te gang ba dang*/ lag gnyis sngar bcas pa'i byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya de kha sbyar la gru mo gnyis pus mo gnyis las mi 'da' bar g.yas su bskor/ tshul des mar khu dgang gzar gsum mam bdun gyis byon zan dbul/ me pra 'di skabs kho nar brtag pa dang 'di nas brtsams te ji srid thab kyi bud shing rnams kyi nus pa ma rdzogs pa de srid du brtag pa ste lugs gnyis las snga ma ltar brtag la/ de'i tshul ni sbyin sreg 'od kyi snye mar/ rab bsngags dge ba'i me yi 'od// dpal be'u dang ni rnga g.yab gdugs// rgyal mtshan pad+ma lta bu dang*// rtse gsum pa dang ral gri nya// bkra shis in+d+ra nī la'i mdog /rdo rje dung la sogs pa dang*// dgang gzar blugs gzar rnam pa dang*// dkar dang 'ja' 'dra mdog sdug dang*// g.yas su 'khyil dang shin tu snum// byi ru dang ni gser mdog 'dra// dngul dang rin chen bai ḍūr+ya// nyi 'od 'bar mtshungs dri ma med// du ba med cing dri zhim pa// mṛ dang ga yi sgra ldan mchog /ces pa rnams kyis dge ba'i ltas shes par bya la// 'on te mi dge ba'i mtshan ma yang de nyid las/ du ba dku zhing me stag 'phro// kun nas sdang zhing sgra dang bcas// myur du chad cing zhan pa dang*// mdangs rtsub pa la sha yi mdog /de bzhin ba glang mgo 'dra dang*// mi ro'i dri dang nya yi dri// bong bu'i dri can bgegs yod yin// zhes bstan pa rnams kyis me pra brtag /ngan na bsang chu gtor zhing las sngags dang sum+bha nis bgegs bskrad/ ha bya sogs byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar khu dgang gzar gsum mam bdun dbul lo// de nas bsreg rdzas dbul te/ yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing du mos la rtse mo steng du bstan la g.yas pa'i mtheb srin nam gung mtheb kyis dbul zhing*/

oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swā hā/ zhes lha sngags tshar gcig rdzas sngags re dang yam shing re bstun te dbul zhing sngags bzla grogs yod na du yod kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i yam shing sngags re la dbul/ grangs 'dzin pa pos kyang de nyid kyi grangs 'dzin pa ste/ deng sang sbyin sreg la grangs rkun byed pa'ang 'di nas 'tshugs pa yin pas grangs rkun mi byed cing tshar gsum re'am bdun re'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya/ zhes pa'i rjes su 'dod gsol ni/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes mar khu dgang blugs kyis dbul mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes til nag mtheb srin nam gung mtheb kyis dbul/ 'bru gzhan rnams dang ku sha dang dūrba yang mtheb srin nam gung mtheb kyis dbul/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// sdig sgrib zhi byed las rnams la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba ar+tha sid+dha ye swā hā/ yungs kar te mthar/ oṃ sarba ar+tha sid+dha ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad dang*// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shin+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/

zas mchog ste mthar/ oṃ sarba sam+ba de/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun/ sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ de yang zas mchog ril bu yin na mtheb mdzub dang phye ma yin na blugs gzar gyis so// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ zho ste mthar/ oṃ sarba sam+ba de/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// shes rab phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes blugs gzar gyis dbul/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras so ba ste mthar/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// khyim gyi dpal 'byor rgyas pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra bī dzā ya swā hā/ so ba ste mthar/ oṃ badz+ra bī dzā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// nor dang 'bru rnams rgyas pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ma hā be gā ye swā hā/ nas te mthar/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// lus kyi shugs rnams rgyas pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma ste mthar/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// lus kyi stobs rnams rgyas pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/

oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ghasma re swā hā/ gro ste mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma re/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// lus kyi nad rnams med pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūrba ste mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// tshe srog ring du gnas pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hā/ ku sha ste mthar/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun phyogs rnams srung ba la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ṣī bā ya swā hā/ shing tog ste mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ṣī bā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ de yang sdig pa zhi bar 'dod na til lhag par dbul zhing gzhan rnams gang 'byor dang*/ de bzhin du tshe ring bar 'dod na dūrba dbul ba sogs kun la shes par bya/ mar khu dang yam shing ni thams cad la dgos so/ gshin don dang zhi rkyang la ni spel tshig /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// zhes sam yang na/ che ge'i sdig sgrib rgyu bcas kun// zhes pa tsam kha bsgyur bas chog go /bde mchog sdom byung sogs las ni/ yam shing ni 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la'o// khu ba'i rdzas rnams ni zhal du'o// gong bu'i rdzas rnams ni phyag tu'o// ku sha ni gdan du'o// dūrba dang me tog ni dbu la'o// zhes 'byung ba ltar byed pa'ang yod do// me gso ba'i phyir bar bar du mar khu dgang blugs kyis dbul lo// de nas me lha'i mchod bstod ni/

gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i bdug spos 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ lha rdzas dam pa'i snang gsal 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i dri chab 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal zas 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra nai wid+ya pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di// drang song me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing = lha rdzas 'chi med bdud rtsi 'di// drang srong = bzhes nas= oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra pañca a mṛ ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing = zung 'jug bde chen mchod pa 'di// drang srong = bzhes nas= oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ma taṅgi pra tits+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ drang srong chen po me lha yis// sngon gyi dam bcas mna' dor ba// lha rnams zhal ni me yin te// sbyin sreg de ni me la gnas// oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/

zhes mar khu dgang blugs gsum phul nas/ rgyal rgyam lha dgur/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kri ta badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa lta bu'i cho ga gang yin gyi las sngags dang bsang chus me dang yo byad rnams bsangs la/ me lha 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// 'od zhu 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo/// /gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i cho ga ni/ me lha'i lto ba'am thugs kar ram me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur ba'i dbus su 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ste lugs gsum las phyi ma ltar byas te/ de'i dbus su zhes mtshams sbyar la cho ga so so'i bdag bskyed kha spos te mdun bskyed dbang bskur rgyas gdab kyi bar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su sgom pa las 'dir rgyal rgyam lha dgu'i cho gar mtshon na thab dbus su dkyil 'khor dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ de'i dbus su 'od zer las grub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams pad+ma rā ga las grub pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje yangs shing rgya che ba'i lte bar byang chub kyi shing snying po rgyan yid du 'ong ba 'bras bu dang lo ma thams cad nor bu rin po che bkra shis rdzas brgyad du grub pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan rgyas pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'o// pad+ma'i lte bar buṃ las gzhal yas kyi khang pa phyogs mdog gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ ka ba brgyad kyis yang dag par mdzes pa/ dbus su zlum bskor gtso bo'i 'dom gang ba/ de'i nam mkha' la rgya gram gyi gdung gi mthar rin po che'i gdung zlum po rgya gram gyi khong gseng du zug pa/ de'i mthar rdo rje'i gdung zlum po/ de'i mthar 'khor lo'i gdung zlum po/ de'i mthar rgya gram gyi gdung gi sna bzhi phyir lhag pa la rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa ste thog gi dbyibs so// phyi'i dbyibs log re re la gtso bo'i 'dom brgyad dang ldan pa/

ye shes lnga'i brdar rtsig pa rim pa lnga nang nas rim bzhin dmar po/ sngon po/ ser po/ dkar po/ ljang gu ste/ pad+ma rā ga dang*/ baiḍūr+ya dang*/ gser dang*/ shel dang*/ ma rgad las grub pa zheng du khru lnga/ 'phangs su 'dom gsum pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu khru gang ba'i steng du/ rin po che baiḍūr+ya lta bu mun pa'i snam bu 'dom phyed pa/ de la ba so'i gseng khang khru gang ba'i bar bar du rin po che'i bre la rtsi pa tra'i kha nas byung ba'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du gdung gi sna la rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa/ phyi la 'dom phyed lhag pa'i tshul gyis 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang mnyam pa'i steng du rdo kra ma shīr+ṣa las grub pa'i mda' yab kyis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi glo 'bur gyi tshul du gnas pa la ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs cha bzhi bzhis mdzes pa/ gtso bo'i tog gi rdo rje rgya gram gyi steng du chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa bcu gsum dang ldan pa la gdugs char khebs dar dpyangs dang tog gis spras pa/ rta babs re re'i steng du chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa bcu pa char khebs tog bcas phyogs bzhi na ri dwags bzhi bzhi/ mtshams bzhi na ba dan bzhi bzhi/ rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi snam bus 'khor ba'i zur bcu gnyis la ba dan bcu gnyis kyis mtshan pa/ de'i phyi rol du chus bcad pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i ra ba gur khang me ri dang bcas pa'o// de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥbabs pa las 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod/ sems can la phog sdig sgrib dag nas 'od du zhu/ oṃ ā hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sems can thams cad thugs rje chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ 'od zer tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim nas yongs su gyur pa las/

bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis yum gyi rgyab tu 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og mas rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi 'og mas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gnyis phyag gnyis ma/ phag zhal dmar mo spyi gtsug tu phyung ba/ rtsa ba'i khro zhal spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba la thod pa skam po lngas brgyan cing*/ thod pa rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug nam mkhar phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa/ zhabs gnyis yab kyi rgyab nas 'khril ba'i tshul gyis skyil mo krung bcas nas bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyogs bzhir pad nyi'i steng du yi ge hrīḥbazhi las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mi bskyod pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma sngon mo dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan spyan ras gzigs/ sku mdog dmar mo/ yum mā mā kī ser mo dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yum gos dkar mo dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ byang du don yod grub pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ de dag thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi phyag dang po rnams lha mo la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyar ba/

g.yas kyi 'og ma rnams ni mu tig dmar po'i bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma rnams ni me tog pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha mo rnams kyi phyag dang po dag kyang rang rang gi bdag po'i rgyab tu thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma rnams ni rim pa bzhin 'khor lo dang rin po che dang pad+ma dkar po dang ut+pal 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma rnams ni pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa// zhabs gnyis yab kyi rgyab tu 'khril ba'i tshul gyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa la dar gyi cod pan dang rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa'o// shar lho'i mtshams su ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon pad+ma/ lho nub tu ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo g.yas nor bu/ g.yon pad+ma/ nub byang du ni las pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo g.yas bum pa/ g.yon pad+ma/ byang shar du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu g.yas ral gri/ g.yon pad+ma bsnams pa/ sku la rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o// phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la 'khod pa'i lha mo rnams ni gzugs rdo rje ma me long dang pad+ma/ sgra rdo rje ma gling bu dang pad+ma/ dri rdo rje ma spos phor dang pad+ma/ ro rdo rje ma mkhar gzhong dang pad+ma/ reg rdo rje ma na bza' dang pad+ma bsnams pa'o// lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par nyi ma la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar pad+ma la hūm̐ sngon po dang hrīḥdamar po/ yab rnams kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥl/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ gis g.yas su bskor ba/ yum rnams kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥl/ oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī bud dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

zhes pas g.yon du bskor ba rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar ha ri ni sas mtshan pa'o// zhes pa'i rjes su slob dpon nam las kyi rdo rjes dkyil 'khor gyi drung du byon te yig brgya brjod bzhin pas mchod yon sbreng spos phor 'dzin pas/ rten ni rdul tshon nam ras bris dkyil 'khor la// bzhugs pa'i brten pa dkyil 'khor pa// thab kyi dbus kyi dkyil 'khor du// deng 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// zhes snyan gsan dbab ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dzaḥ sogs gtso 'khor so so'i snying po brjod bzhin pas me tog lha'i ngo bor mos te/ rdul tshon nam ras bris dkyil nas len pa'i tshul gyis rin po che'i snod du blangs shing bkur sti dang bcas pas sbyin sreg khang par spyan drangs te/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ gyis sgras bskul nas thab kyi steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da'i bar dang/ pañca a mṛ ta/ badz+ra ma taṅgi/ bcas mchod pa gsum gyis mchod cing mthar/ so so'i snying po/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+wam̐/ btags pa brjod cing me tog mthor de bzhin du/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dzaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+wam̐ sogs brjod cing me tog mthor bas rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas se gol bya zhing thab tu bzhugs pa sngar bskyed pa dang dbyer med du bzhugs par mos la/ thab kyi pad+ma'i dbus su bzhugs par gyur// ces brjod nas thab kyi dbus su me tog gcig dor te thab tu bskyed pa dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa de la spro na ye shes pa gzhug par bya ba sogs kyang gsungs pas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rten dang brten par bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par gyur/

rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ lho nub srin po'i grong khyer nas// grub thob bye ba 'bum gyi dbus// slob dpon pad+ma gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas// mgon po tshe dbang 'od dpag med// spyan ras gzigs dbang gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mkha' spyod dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyi dbus// yum gcig mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// rta mchog rgyal po he ru ka /dpa' bo'i tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol// dbang bskur= dag pa sku yi gzhal yas nas// chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro= dbang bskur= mi 'gyur thugs kyi gzhal yas nas// me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// rdo rje mkha' 'gro= dbang bskur= pad+ma gsung gi gzhal yas nas// sor rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid// pad+ma mkha' 'gro= dbang bskur= yon tan rgyas pa'i gzhal yas nas// mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid// rin chen mkha' 'gro= dbang bskur= phrin las grub pa'i gzhal yas nas// bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid// las kyi mkha' 'gro= dbang bskur= 'jig rten dur khrod gzhal yas nas// bsam gyis mi khyab sprul pa'i tshogs// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro= phrin las rnams bzhi bsgrub tu gsol// dam tshig chen po'i gnas mchog nas// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral tshogs// dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol// pho nya las mkhan mdzad du gsol// zhes rol mo bya/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs// 'gro ba'i don du byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ swā hā/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/

oṃ/ mchod yon bdug spos me tog snang gsal dri// zhal zas rol mo sha lnga rigs kyi yum// zag med bde chen bdud rtsi bde ba'i gnas// sha chen gsur dud zhun me dga' bde rgyas// snang ba sna tshogs lhan skyes ye shes bde// rang byung kun mkhyen ye shes mchod pa'i sprin// mchod par bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ dhū pe/ puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig sems dpa' dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi 'khor lo gsal bar gyur/ lha la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rin po che'i bum pa thogs pa dpag tu med pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar gyur// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bum pa'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// chos dbyings ye shes dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bud dha a bhi ṣeñca oṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa= lha rnams kyis ni= lha yi chu ni= de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhī ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur zhing chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la snang ba mtha' yas/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs kyi yab yum rnams la mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu brgyan pa'o// byon zan dbul ba ni/ dgang blugs kha la hūm̐ yig gsal// bcom ldan 'das ma'i ljags la yang*// hūm̐ yig dag gis mtshan pa yis// bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi bzhes par gyur// ces pa'i rjes su dkyil 'khor gang yin gyi gtso bo'i snying po rgyal rgyam la mtshon na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dzaḥ

sngags lan bdun gyis mar khu dgang la mthar spel tshig ni/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ de ltar sngags lan bdun re'i mtshams su 'dod gsol lan re bcas lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ mchod bzhi bstod bzhi ni/ mchod rdzas la bdud rtsi gtor nas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ bdug spos/ me tog /mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin dwangs shing thogs pa med pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed rgyas par 'gengs shing 'phro ba/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yāṃ= a tsa mā naṃ= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= dhū pe= puṣ+pe= a lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wid+ya= shab+da āḥhūm̐ bar dang*/ de nas phyi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyang slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// khams gsum gnas pa'i dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yāṃ= a tsa mā naṃ= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldan pas/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig

/oṃ āḥsogs sngags thog mtha' 'gre ba'i/ badz+ra dhū pe= dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa'i// lha rdzas dbyibs legs me tog dam pa 'di// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas// gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin gtibs gyur cig /puṣ+pe= nyon mongs dug sreg ma rig mun sel ba'i// shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me 'di// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// 'od zer snang bas phyogs bcur gsal gyur cig /ā lo ke= stong gsum kun tu dri dang ngad ldan pa'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i khrus// ye shes sprin phung mkha' la thugs rje'i char rgyun gyis// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /gan+dhe= rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i bshos// dag cing gtsang mar bshams te 'bul lags na// bsod nams zhing gyur rnams kyis bzhes su gsol// nai wid+ya= dril chen sil snyan rnam grol tshangs pa'i dbyangs// bsam dag ngag gis bstod de gus mchod 'bul// sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas sangs rgyas sar// tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas chos kyi rgyal por shog /shab+da= rol mo bya/ hūm̐/ dus gsum bde gshegs yum gcig ma// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'gro la gzigs// gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// sku mdog dmar mo dbang gi tshul// tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad// rnam rtog rtsad gcod gri gug g.yas// 'khor ba dbang sdud thod khrag g.yon// skye 'chi rtsad gcod ral gri g.yas// dug gsum rtsad gcod kha ṭāṃ g.yon// thabs dang shes rab brkyang bskum bzhugs// 'dod yon rang dag rus pas brgyan// gzhon nu'i cha lugs cung zad khro// thugs rjes chags pas dbang du sdud// nam mthong dran pas ye shes skye// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// rdo rje rigs kyi dngos grub stsol// rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// nor dang bsod nams dngos grub stsol// pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// chags pa dbang sdud dngos grub stsol// las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma// dgra bgegs tshar gcod dngos grub stsol// mkha' gsang ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// chos dbyings lhun grub dngos grub stsol// ma hā mu dra'i dngos grub stsol// rol mo bya/

nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ dug lnga rnam par dag pa yi// rigs lnga dang ni ye shes lnga// sha chen lnga yi mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// 'byung ba lnga po rnam dag pa// mā ma kī la sogs pa yi// rigs kyi yum chen 'byung ba lnga// shes rab dri med mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med cing*// zung 'jug bde ba chen po yi// kha dog yid 'ong reg byar ldan// zag med bde chen mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dbang bzhi bskur dang rgyud bzhi smin// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsol// rol mo bya/ hūm̐/ thugs kyi lha mchog rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal// sku mdog dmar nag dregs pa dbang du sdud// spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// zhal gyi 'dzum tshul thugs rjes kun la snyoms// mche bzhi gtsigs pas skye shi rtsad nas gcod// dbu gtsug rta mgo gzhan gyis 'gran du med// rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud// dbang sdud phyag rgyas skye 'gro zil gyis gnon// pad+ma'i phyag mtshan 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral// rin chen rgyan cha 'dod yon ma spangs dag /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ye shes sems dpa'i tshul// dbang chen rta mchog sku la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'jig rten dbang du sdud// 'jig rten zil gnon phrin las dngos grub stsol// rol mo bya/ gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ thabs dang shes rab dbyer med cing*// yab yum bcu yi sbyor ba las// zag med bde ba chen po yi// ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// pad+ma rang byung me tog la// rak+ta rang byung bde ba'i gnas// sha chen gsur dang bdug spos dang*// zhun chen snang gsal sgron me rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// lhan skyes bde ba chen po yi// dga' ba bzhi dang bde ba brgyad// zag med nyams kyis brgyan pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du// dpa' bo'i tshogs bcas rnal 'byor ma// gnyis med bde chen rol pa las// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol// dbang bzhi bskur dang rgyud bzhi smin// gsang ba bla med dngos grub stsol// zhes rol mo bya/

'gro ba kun la thugs rjes mnyam par gzigs// nyi ma'i 'od zer sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chags rab don gyi 'gro ba dbang du sdud// rdo rje phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sngags kyi las mdzad mdzes pa mkha' 'gro'i tshul// rgya mtsho gling gi mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// las kyi bka' sdod byin rlabs thogs med 'bebs// rdo rje phra men sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstan pa'i ru 'dzin gdug pa'i dgra 'dul ma// mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnal 'byor 'khor skyong byin brlabs char ltar 'bebs// mkha' 'gro zhi ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i// phyi nang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la// gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rol mo bya/ chos sku skye 'gag med pa la// rang byung ye shes mchod par 'bul// dus gsum skye 'gag med pa la// snang ba sna tshogs mchod par 'bul// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med cing*// lhan skyes ye shes bde ba che// zag med bde chen mchod par 'bul// dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i dngos grub stsol// dbyings dang ye shes ro mnyam zhing*// 'gag med ye shes lnga dang ldan// kun mkhyen ye shes mchod par 'bul// ngo bo nyid kyi dngos grub stsol// zhes de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul zhing rol mo bya'o// hūm̐/ mi 'gyur thugs kyis bdud bcom rdo rje'i rigs// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// re skong bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs rin chen rigs// rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chags pa thams cad dbang sdud pad+ma'i rigs// pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// don grub gdug pa 'dul mdzad las kyi rigs// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// gdug pa 'dul mdzad rdo rje'i rigs su sprul// rdo rje ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'byung bar byed pa yi// rin chen ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chags rab don gyis 'gro ba dbang du sdud// pad+ma'i ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// las kyi mtha' yis bstan pa'i ru dra 'dul// las kyi ging chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dgongs pa lon pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis// bdag dang mos pa'i gang zag la// byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun bzhin phob// rol mo bya/

g.yon pa'i srin mdzub kyis bdud rtsi blangs nas nam mkhar mchod cing*/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ longs sku thugs rje chen po'i zhal du= sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal du= ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i= te pu pa dri med bshes gnyen= ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i= bla ma zangs ri ras pa'i= 'gro mgon ras pa chen po'i= rgyal sras spom brag pa'i= grub chen karma pak+shi'i= gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum gyi= chos rje rang byung rdo rje'i= mkhas btsun rin chen rgyal mtshan= maṃ ga la ke tu'i= rin chen bzang po'i= kun mkhyen mthong ba don ldan= byang sems dpal 'byor don grub= rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho'i= grub chen bkra shis dpal 'byor= mtshungs med mi bskyod rdo rje'i= rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag= rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje'i= gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug= rgyal mchog chos dbyings rdo rje'i= dpal ldan ye shes snying po'i= mtshungs med ye shes rdo rje'i= dpal chen chos kyi don grub= rgyal dbang byang chub rdo rje'i= si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas= rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje'i= mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho'i= pad+ma nyin byed dbang po'i= theg pa mchog gi rdo rje'i= rgyal sras blo gros mtha' yas= kun bzang mkha' khyab rdo rje'i= pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po'i= dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer= rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje'i= drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lha lnga'i brgyud rim mam/ yang na/ 'jig rten dbang phyug zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pad+ma badz+ra zhal du= dza lan+dha ra'i= mai tri pa'i= badz+ra pā ṇi'i= bha dan+ta su ma ti kīr+t+ti'i= ras chung rdo rje grags pa la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs// spyan ras gzigs bzhi rigs kyi yum bzhi mchod// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro dpa' bo rgya mtsho dang*// dpa' mo rgya mtsho grub pa brnyes pa rnams// dam can rgya mtsho bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ rgyas skabs gtso 'khor so sor 'bul ba'am/ bsdu na gtso 'khor bsdoms nas gtso bo'i snying po la sa pa ri wā ra sbyar chog par gsungs par da lta'i phyag bzhes su de bzhin mdzad pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dzaḥ sa pa ri wā ra oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swā hā/ zhes lha sngags tshar gcig gis sna drangs rdzas sngags re dang yam shing re bstun la 'bul/ zla grogs du yod kyi grangs dang bstun nas 'bul zhing grangs rkun mi byed par grangs 'dzin pa sogs gong gsal 'jig rten pa'i skabs ltar bya zhing*/ bzlas pa'i kha skong gi grangs gsog pa'ang 'di bzhin gsog dgos so// grangs grub mtshams spel tshig ni/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes grangs dang lha sngags spel tshig sbyor tshul 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gres kyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dzaḥs pa ri wā ra oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes mar khu dgang blugs kyis dbul mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dzaḥs pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā/ til nag mtheb srin nam gung mtheb kyis dbul/ 'bru gzhan rnams dang ku sha dang dūrba yang mtheb srin nam gung mtheb kyis dbul mthar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya/

bdag cag= sdig sgrib zhi byed las rnams la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐= oṃ sarba ar+tha sid+dha ye swā hā/ yungs kar te/ bdag cag= gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad dang*// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐= oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ zas mchog ste/ bdag cag= bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ de yang zas mchog ril bu yin na mtheb mdzub dang phye ma yin na blugs gzar gyis dbul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐= oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ zho ste/ bdag cag= shes rab phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes blugs gzar gyis dbul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐= oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras so ba ste/ bdag cag= khyim gyi dpal 'byor rgyas pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐= oṃ badz+ra bī dzā ya swā hā/ nas so ba ste/ bdag cag= nor dang 'bru rnams rgyas pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐= oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ nas ste/ bdag cag= lus kyi shugs rnams rgyas pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐= oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma ste/ bdag cag= lus kyi stobs rnams rgyas pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐= oṃ badz+ra ghasma re swā hā/ gro ste/ bdag cag= lus kyi nad rnams med pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐= oṃ badz+ra ā u ṣe swā hā/

dūrba ste/ bdag cag= tshe srog ring du gnas pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐= oṃ a pra ti ha da badz+rā ya swā hā/ ku sha ste/ bdag cag= mi mthun phyogs rnams srung ba la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dzaḥs pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ṣī bā ya swā hā/ shing tog sna tshogs ste/ oṃ badz+ra ṣī ba ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ de yang sdig pa zhi bar 'dod na til lhag par dbul zhing*/ gzhan rnams gang 'byor ram ma 'byor kyang rung la/ de bzhin du tshe ring bar 'dod na dūr+wa sogs kun la shes par bya/ mar khu dang yam shing ni thams cad la dgos/ gshin don dang zhi rkyang la spel tshig ni/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// zhes sam yang na/ che ge'i sdig sgrib rgyu bcas kun// zhes pa tsam gyis chog go// bsnyen pa'i kha skong gsog skabs rdzas thams cad phyogs gcig tu spungs pa phye ma dang bsres te mang du spel la/ gong gi shing tog 'bul ba'i mjug tu zur gsal phyag bzhes ltar gtso bo'i snying por 'bru gsum btags te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dzaḥs pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'bul zhing grangs lnga bcu'am brgya re sogs kyi mtshams su 'dod gsol ni/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad don kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ rol mo yang bya'o// de'i mjug tu na bza'/

me tog tsan dan dkar dmar/ a ga ru/ spos sogs yod na rang rang gi tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas cho ga rang rang gi gzhung la yod na de ka ltar 'bul ba/ dper na rgyal rgyam la mtshon na/ dpag med bsod nams stobs las byung ba yis// ngo tsha khrel yod ldan pa lha yi gos// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ na bza' dang*/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa'i// lha rdzas dbyibs legs me tog dam pa 'di// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas// gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin gtibs gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ me tog rigs dbul/ tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs nas// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldang ba'i// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ badz+ra dhū pe pra tits+tsha sogs kyis bdug spos 'bul ba lta bu'am/ med na snying po'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la 'bul zhing*/ rin po che sman sogs kyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ sogs snying po'i mjug tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags la phul/ gzhan yang las mthun gyi khrus ras dang gos zung kyang bshams gsungs pa'i rigs pas khrus byed par spro na/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ phyi ba ni/ de dag sku la sogs/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥsogs kyis phyi/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta bi dha ni hūm̐/ zhes bkru/ de dag sku la sogs kyis phyi/ lhag bsam dag pa'i sogs/

sna tshogs dbang po'i sogs/ srab 'jam yang pa sogs/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra āḥhūm̐/ zhes khrus phyi ba gos zung 'bul ba sogs bya'o// khrus kyi bskor 'di mi spro na ma byas kyang chad skyon med do/// /de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rjes kyi mchod bstod gtor 'bul ni/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ bdug spos/ me tog /mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin dwangs shing thogs pa med pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed rgyas par 'gengs shing 'phro ba/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yāṃ= a tsa mā naṃ= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= dhū pe= puṣ+pe= a lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wid+ya= shab+da āḥhūm̐ bar dang*/ de nas phyi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyang slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// khams gsum gnas pa'i dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ= a tsa mā naṃ= prok+ṣā ṇaṃ= tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldan pas/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /oṃ āḥsogs sngags thog mtha' 'gre ba'i/ badz+ra dhū pe= dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa'i// lha rdzas dbyibs legs me tog dam pa 'di// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas// gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin gtibs gyur cig

/puṣ+pe= nyon mongs dug sreg ma rig mun sel ba'i// shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me 'di// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// 'od zer snang bas phyogs bcur gsal gyur cig /ā lo ke= stong gsum kun tu dri dang ngad ldan pa'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i khrus// ye shes sprin phung mkha' la thugs rje'i char rgyun gyis// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /gan+dhe= rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i bshos// dag cing gtsang mar bshams te 'bul lags na// bsod nams zhing gyur rnams kyis bzhes su gsol// nai wid+ya= dril chen sil snyan rnam grol tshangs pa'i dbyangs// bsam dag ngag gis bstod de gus mchod 'bul// sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas sangs rgyas sar// tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas chos kyi rgyal por shog /shab+da bar gyis mchod/ rol mo bya/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku// sku mdog dmar gsal 'jig rten dbang du sdud// spyan gyi 'od zer 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs// zhal nas hūm̐ sgras stong gsum chos sgra sgrog /shangs nas ye shes rlung gis nyon mongs 'thor// snyan gnyis thabs dang shes rab 'dul thabs mdzad// phyag gnyis dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med sbyor// g.yas pas bgrang phreng byang chub lam sna 'dren// g.yon pas pad+ma 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral// zhabs gnyis 'gro ba'i don la snyoms par bzhugs// rin chen rgyan drug pha rol phyin drug ldan// 'gro rnams ma lus thugs rjes dbang du sdud// 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dgyes par rol pas 'dzab bstod mchod pa bzhes// dbang dang dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// gsung gi dbang phyug snang ba mtha' yas sku// 'chi med tshe dbang mgon po 'od dpag med// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad gsung las sprul// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// mi dmigs don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// sogs kyis bstod/

'das gtor 'bul ba ni/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta sogs dang*/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs bsangs sbyangs la/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi thugs ka nas/ yaṃ 'phros pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam ba dan dang yaṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ spros pa las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po 'bar ba raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de la kaṃ gsum spros pa las thod pa skam po bum ril gyi sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a spros pa las thod pa'i snod phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dbus su mu las dri chu baiḍūr+ya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor ra las rak+ta gser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las klad pa ste bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lhor go las ba lang gi sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha /byang shar du ha las rta yi sha ste sha lnga'o// rlung g.yos shing me sbar bas thod pa dros rdzas rnams zhu ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog sngon po'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha dog dkar po 'o ma'i rgya mtsho lta bur gyur/ rgyas na/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams sprin gyi phung po lta bur bzhugs par gyur/ rdor thal kha phye bas/ na mo rat+na gu ru i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ te pu pa dri med bshes gnyen/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ bla ma zangs ri ras pa/ 'gro mgon ras pa chen po/ rgyal sras spom brag pa/ grub chen karma pak+shi/ gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje/

mkhas btsun rin chen rgyal mtshan/ maṃ ga la ke tu/ rin chen bzang po/ kun mkhyen mthong ba don ldan/ byang sems dpal 'byor don grub/ rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho/ grub chen bkra shis dpal 'byor/ mtshungs med mi bskyod rdo rje/ rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag /rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje/ gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug /rgyal mchog chos dbyings rdo rje/ dpal ldan ye shes snying po/ mtshungs med ye shes rdo rje/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub/ rgyal dbang byang chub rdo rje/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas/ rje btsun bdud 'dul rdo rje/ mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho/ pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ theg pa mchog gi rdo rje/ rgyal sras blo gros mtha' yas/ kun bzang mkha' khyab rdo rje/ pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po/ dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer/ rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo// byin gyis rlobs par mdzad du gsol/ yang na/ 'jig rten dbang phyug /pad+ma badz+ra/ dza lan+dā ra/ mai tri pa/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ bha dan+ta su ma ti kir+t+ti/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo// byin gyis rlobs par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī= i daṃ= oṃ dhū ma gha= i daṃ= bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ rdo rje phag mo/ rdo rje rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ rin chen rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ pad+ma rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ las kyi rigs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ sangs rgyas spyan ma/ mā ma kī/ gos dkar mo/ dam tshig sgrol ma/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo// mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi/ trag rak+ṣa ma hi dun bh+yo ma hā yak+ṣa tīk+ṣ+ṇa kā li dun bh+yo/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma hā kā la bdud 'dul rdo rje'i ded dpon 'jig byed chen po ber nag can/ dregs pa pho dgu/ mo dgu/ phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po bcu/ dregs pa'i gtso bo bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ ye shes kyi mgon po'i tshogs/ las kyi mgon po'i tshogs/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po'i tshogs rnams dang*/ dpal ldan lha mo rang byung gi rgyal mo srung ma dpal ldan ma/ ma mo bdun/ sring mo bzhi/ 'bar ma dgu/ dus bzhi'i lha mo/ dmag gi rgyal mo bzhi/ dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang bka' brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bdag gi phrin las rnam pa bzhi 'grub pa dang*/ bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams bsal du gsol/ zhes sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ 'dod don gsol ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dzaḥ mar khu dgang blugs gsum dbul/ thal mo sbyar la 'dod gsol ni/ lhag pa'i lha mchog bcom ldan 'das// 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// zla ba mar gyi ngo bzhin du// zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// de ltar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i skabs su dmigs pa ji ltar bya ba ni/ sgrib gnyis sreg byed las gsungs pa ltar/ rang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal du 'phos te thugs ka nas 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun lta bu spros pas/ bsgrub bya'i sgo gsum bkrus te nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi bar bsgom mo// de bzhin du 'od zer ser pos tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang gzi brjid rgyas pa dang*/

'od zer dmar pos lcags kyu lta bus gang la dmigs pa'i snying ga nas bzung mdun du bkug ste bran ltar gyur pa dang*/ 'od zer mthing nag gnam lcags kyi thog lta bus dgra bgegs kyi snying gar phog pas srog mar me lta bu thum gyi bsad de thal bar brlag par bsams pa sogs gsungs pa ltar so so'i man ngag bzhin bya'o/// /de nas gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ rgyas na/ mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ bdug spos/ me tog /mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin dwangs shing thogs pa med pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed rgyas par 'gengs shing 'phro ba/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yāṃ= a tsa mā naṃ= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= dhū pe= puṣ+pe= a lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wid+ya= shab+da āḥhūm̐ bar dang*/ oṃ/ mchod yon bdug spos me tog snang gsal dri// zhal zas rol mo sha lnga rigs kyi yum// zag med bde chen bdud rtsi bde ba'i gnas// sha chen gsur dud zhun me dga' bde rgyas// snang ba sna tshogs lhan skyes ye shes bde// rang byung kun mkhyen ye shes mchod pa'i sprin// mchod par bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ= a tsa mā naṃ= prok+ṣā ṇaṃ= dhū pe= sogs kyis mchod/ bsdu na sngags mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ

oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha sogs nas/ shab+da'i bar mchod pa dang*/ sa khams rang bzhin gti mug rnam par dag /gzugs phung gnas gyur chos dbyings ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// rnam par snang mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// nam mkha'i rang bzhin zhe sdang rnam par dag /rnam shes gnas gyur me long ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// me khams rang bzhin nga rgyal rnam par dag /tshor ba gnas gyur mnyam nyid ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// rin chen 'byung ldan sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// chu khams rang bzhin 'dod chags rnam par dag /'du shes gnas gyur sor rtog ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// 'od dpag med mgon sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rlung khams rang bzhin phrag dog rnam par dag /'du byed gnas gyur bya grub ye shes bdag /bde gshegs kun dngos mgon po spyan ras gzigs// don yod grub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod la/ dril bsil gyis/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pas bdag cag rnams la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ dril bu bsil zhing dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ sogs yig brgya lan gsum brjod la/ shar phyogs su dkyil 'khor la phyogs pas 'dug ste/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// gang yang bdag blo rmongs gyur pas// legs byas 'di la nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// bar gyis nongs pa bshags/

gshegs gsol gyi skabs su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ badz+ra a tsa mā ṇaṃ pra tī ts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes zhal bsil dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ badz+ra prok+ṣā ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas 'thor 'thung 'phul la mchod yon phyag gnyis kyis gus pa dang bcas sbreng bzhin par oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya brjod/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa bsdu/ ༈ rdul tshon sogs 'brel na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// rten gyi'am/ ras bris sam/ rdul tshon gnas su gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya hūm̐ dzaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+wam̐/ zhes so so'i snying po brjod bzhin pas me tog thab dbus nas len pa'i tshul gyis snod du blangs/ mthar slob dpon gyis slob ma la gtad/ slob mas dkyil 'khor la ma gnod par gtor te dkyil 'khor gang yin de'i sngags gong bzhin brjod la/ rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi ni dkyil 'khor la// lha tshogs thams cad thim par gyur par bsam mo/// /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes pas mar khu dgang blugs gsum mam bdun phul nas/ slar yang me lha 'khor bcas rnams// 'bar ba'i rnam pa las bzhengs te// drang srong dag gi cha byad can// gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam la/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma gang yod grangs tshad mi 'dzin par gong gsal 'jig rten pa'i skabs sor bzhag ltar 'bul dgos pas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā/ yam shing ste mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*/

'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gres kyis/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar khu ste/ bdag cag dpon slob= 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par= 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā/ til nag ste/ bdag cag= sdig sgrib zhi byed las rnams la// bar du gcod par= 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba ar+tha sid+dha ye swā hā/ yungs kar te/ bdag cag= gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad dang*// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ zas mchog ste/ bdag cag= bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ zho mchog ste/ bdag cag= shes rab phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras so ba ste/ bdag cag= khyim gyi dpal 'byor rgyas pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra bī dzā ya swā hā/ nas so ba ste/ bdag cag= nor dang 'bru rnams rgyas pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ nas ste/ bdag cag= lus kyi shugs rnams rgyas pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma ste/ bdag cag= lus kyi stobs rnams rgyas pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ghasma re swā hā/

gro ste/ bdag cag= lus kyi nad rnams med pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūrba ste/ bdag cag= tshe srog ring du gnas pa la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swā hā/ ku sha ste/ bdag cag= mi mthun phyogs rnams srung ba la// bar du= 'gro ba'i= sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ṣī bā ya swā hā/ shing tog ste mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ṣī bā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// rigs brgyud phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ mthar khrus gsol spro na/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ badz+ra was+t+ra'i bar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i skabs ltar dang*/ mchod bstod ni/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā// gtsang zhing= lha rdzas dam pa'i bdug spos 'di// drang srong= bzhes nas= dhū pe= gtsang zhing= lha rdzas dam pa'i snang gsal 'di// drang srong= bzhes nas= a lo ke= gtsang zhing= lha rdzas dam pa'i dri chab 'di// drang srong= bzhes nas= gan+dhe= gtsang zhing= lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal zas 'di// drang srong= bzhes nas= nai wid+ya= gtsang zhing= lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di// drang srong= bzhes nas= shab+da= gtsang zhing= lha rdzas 'chi med bdud rtsi 'di// drang srong= bzhes nas= oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra pañca a mṛ ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing= zung 'jug bde chen mchod pa 'di// drang srong= bzhes nas= oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ma taṅgi pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cas sreg

/'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ me lha'i gtor ma/ a kā ros byin gyis brlabs te/ dgang blugs su bzung la/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum brjod bzhin pas thab khung du dbul/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la| |nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las bcol/ 'dod don gsol ba ni thal mo sbyar te/ drang srong chen po me yi lha// 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// zla ba mar gyi ngo bzhin du// zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol// ces so// de nas yig brgya brjod la/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// gshegs gsol ni/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra a tsa mā naṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas zhal bsil dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

'thor 'thung phul yig brgya brjod bzhin pas mchod yon sbreng ste/ gshegs gsol gyi dril stabs dang bcas pas/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar byon te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra muḥ ye shes me lha shar lhor gshegs// dam tshig pa rnams snying gar thim/// /de nas bsngo ba smon lam byas ngag grol/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug /long yod na thab kyi me mi bsgul bar bzhag /long med na las mthun gyi chus me mtha' nas zhi bar byas la rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas bsdus te rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor 'dor ba sogs las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la bkra shis brjod do// sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel bar sbyin sreg rkyang pa'i skabs chog gzhung gi bsdus ldang ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das thams cad lhar gsal ba la phog /de thams cad 'od du zhu ste bsrung ba'i gur khang la thim/ de zhu ba las rim bzhin bdag nyid la 'dus te/ bdag nyid thugs ka'i hriḥl thim/ hrīḥyang gong bu dang nā da'i gzugs las rnam par 'das nas rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin no// zhes mnyam par bzhag /slar rang nyid zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i spyan ras gzigs su gsal bar 'gyur/ bkra shis ni/ bka' brgyud bla mas legs byin pa'i// rtag tu ye shes thugs rje yis// gzigs shing chos skur ngo sprod pa'i// byin rlabs mchog gi bkra shis shog /yid dam lha yis legs byin pa'i// gsang sngags mchog gi cho ga la// lus ngag yid gsum mthus grub pa'i// dngos grub mchog gi bkra shis shog /rdo rje mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// sems nyid 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// gnyis med dpe bral don rtogs pa'i// phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// chos rnams rang bzhin rang gi sems// rgyud 'di chos kyis ma bcings pa'i// chos kyi phyag rgya'i bkra shis shog

/rin chen mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// yon tan dpag tu med pas brgyan// nad dang gdon las thar ba yis// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /pad+ma mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med sbyor// bde chen ye shes thabs kyi mchog /gsang ba shes rab bkra shis shog /las kyi mkha' 'gros legs byin pa'i// rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa la// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las rnams 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /zhes dang*/ chos dbyings lhun gyis grub pa la// dbyer med 'khor 'das yongs su rdzogs// dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum// chos sku mchog gi bkra shis shog /rnam snang ye shes gangs chen mtsho// mi 'khrugs rgyal po la sogs pa'i// rgyal ba sras bcas 'khor gyis bskor// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog /thub chen rgyal ba gser mdog can// skal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi dbus// rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa// sprul sku mchog gi bkra shis shog /sku gsum lhun grub yongs rdzogs shing*// ye shes dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du// ngo bo nyid kyi thams cad mkhyen// sku bzhi yongs rdzogs bkra shis shog /sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje ni// yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa ltar// bdag gzhan yongs kyi dbul ba sel// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /byang chub sems kyi phrin las kyi// thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs med 'phro// bco lnga'i zla ba nya rgyas ltar// 'dzam gling 'jig rten bkra shis shog /ces brjod do// grol nyin/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhag pa// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*/ gang yang sa steng gnas pa dang*// sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa// mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su// thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis// sarba bhu ta gats+tsha// zhes pa 'di ni rje mi bskyod zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrib gnyis sreg byed sor bzhag las bzhi myur 'grub las/
